frozen_candidate_root_contribution: qnt = a durative, settled posture of obedient subordination / sustained availability directed to a sovereign authority — invariantly Allah in every explicit case (once jointly to Allah and His Messenger, 33:31). In rational agents this is realized as willed, humble, standing devotional obedience before God (prototypically prolonged standing/night-vigil prayer); in the totality of creation it is involuntary ontological subjection. The single core that survives all 13 is directional 'standing-under / at the disposal of the Sovereign', not any specific act.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: qnt = a durative, settled posture of obedient subordination / sustained availability directed to a sovereign authority — invariantly Allah in every explicit case (once jointly to Allah and His Messenger, 33:31). In rational agents this is realized as willed, humble, standing devotional obedience before God (prototypically prolonged standing/night-vigil prayer); in the totality of creation it is involuntary ontological subjection. The single core that survives all 13 is directional 'standing-under / at the disposal of the Sovereign', not any specific act.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 13 occurrences (one tight Form-I family: 11 active participles qānit/qānitūn/qānitīn/qānitāt plus the verb yaqnut and imperative uqnutī), qnt names being obediently subordinate and continually available to a higher authority, which internally is always God. Wherever an object is stated it is li-llāh / lahū / li-rabbi (16:120, 2:238, 3:43, 2:116, 30:26), extended only once to 'Allah and His Messenger' (33:31) and never to a purely human authority. In people this shows as sustained worshipful standing before God (39:9 through the watches of the night, 2:238 'stand for Allah qānitīn', 3:43 alongside but distinct from bowing and prostration), and as a named virtue-class among the righteous (33:35, 3:17, 66:5, 16:120, 66:12). But the same participle is predicated of all creation in 2:116 / 30:26 ('all are qānitūn to Him'), where it can only mean subjection, not chosen piety. The thin subordination sense bridges every case; the richer devotional content is representative of the human sub-set, not universal.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: qnt does NOT entail: (a) obedience to a human — 4:34 gives qānitāt no human object and the same verse reserves human-directed obedience for أَطَعْنَكُمْ (root ط و ع); (b) prostration or bowing — coordinated as distinct imperatives with وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى (3:43) and set beside سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا (39:9); (c) worship/ʿibāda, islām, khushūʿ, ṣabr, ṣidq — each co-listed as a separate item (33:35, 3:17, 66:5); (d) a punctual act — 11/13 participial, framed with كان/كانت as a settled trait (16:120, 66:12) and explicitly durative (39:9 آنَاءَ ٱللَّيْلِ); (e) literal standing as its core — qiyām co-occurs only in 2:238/39:9 and is absent in cosmic, list and marital uses; (f) exclusively voluntary piety — extended to all creation incl. the deniers being rebutted (2:116).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 2:116:14:1 and its verbatim parallel 30:26:8:1 — كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ predicates qnt of the totality of creation in the heavens and earth, including the very deniers 2:116 rebuts. This decisively falsifies any account that makes distinctive voluntary devout worship the root nucleus: rocks, skies and unbelievers cannot be devout. It forces the core down to involuntary universal subjection, showing the devotional richness of the human verses is contextually supplied, not lexical.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The rich/postural account: qnt = 'sustained humble devotional worship / standing (qiyām) before God', supported by the dense night-vigil and posture collocations (2:238, 39:9, 3:43, 3:17, 16:120). It loses because it cannot accommodate 2:116/30:26 (non-volitional, creation-wide) or the posture-free virtue lists (33:35, 66:5), and is strained by 33:31 (object = Allah AND Messenger). The obedient-subordination nucleus subsumes the postural cases (standing devotion is one enactment) without the reverse holding, so the postural reading is the prototypical manifestation, not the nucleus. A second competitor, 'qnt = generic obedience (ṭāʿa)', is rejected because ṭwʿ freely takes human objects while qnt is God-locked, and the two roots are contrasted in the very same verse (4:34).
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The rich/postural account: qnt = 'sustained humble devotional worship / standing (qiyām) before God', supported by the dense night-vigil and posture collocations (2:238, 39:9, 3:43, 3:17, 16:120). It loses because it cannot accommodate 2:116/30:26 (non-volitional, creation-wide) or the posture-free virtue lists (33:35, 66:5), and is strained by 33:31 (object = Allah AND Messenger). The obedient-subordination nucleus subsumes the postural cases (standing devotion is one enactment) without the reverse holding, so the postural reading is the prototypical manifestation, not the nucleus. A second competitor, 'qnt = generic obedience (ṭāʿa)', is rejected because ṭwʿ freely takes human objects while qnt is God-locked, and the two roots are contrasted in the very same verse (4:34).
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: one Form-I derivational family, an invariant lām-to-Allah argument structure, and a coherent resistant cosmic sub-class (2:116, 30:26). The narrowest account covering all 13 is 'obedient subordination directed to the Sovereign (God)'. This is genuinely distinctive (God-locked directionality; explicitly separated from ṭwʿ, sjd, rkʿ, islām, khushūʿ, ʿibāda) and adversarially survives the contested marital token 4:34 (no human object internally). But two contract conditions cap the grade: (1) a coherent recurring resistant sub-class exists — the cosmic uses realize only the thinned 'subjection' core and strip the distinctive devotional content, edging toward generic ṭāʿa; (2) no single narrow gloss carries the full devotional content across all occurrences. Hence MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE, DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, with the cosmic seam recorded as resistant and 4:34 / 33:31 as reconciled adversarial boundaries. STRONG is rejected because it cannot survive كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Involuntary, universal ontological subjection: the whole of creation in the heavens and earth is qānitūn to Allah — subordinate to and at the disposal of the Sovereign, without volition or devotional affect.
clusters.classification_rationale: Both are the fixed formula كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ with subject = the totality of creation (2:116 including the deniers being rebutted). The active participle here cannot carry chosen piety; it realizes only the thin subordination core, so it resists the distinctive devotional characterization that the human verses invite. It is bridged to the nucleus (directional subordination to God) but is a coherent resistant seam, which is why STRONG is unavailable.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Shared lām-to-Allah directionality (لَّهُۥ) unites these with the human cases; the divergence is purely the absence of volition/enactment.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Willed, sustained, humble obedient devotedness directed to Allah — keeping oneself continually at His disposal — prototypically enacted as prolonged standing before God (night-vigil, dawn) and named as a settled virtue-class of the righteous.
clusters.classification_rationale: Every explicit object is God: li-llāh (16:120, 2:238), li-rabbi (3:43), and once li-llāh wa-rasūlihī (33:31). Durativity is licensed by near-total participial morphology and كان/كانت framing (16:120, 66:12) and explicit آنَاءَ ٱللَّيْلِ (39:9). qnt is coordinated with but distinct from sujūd/rukūʿ (3:43, 39:9) and enumerated separately from islām, khushūʿ, ṣabr, ṣidq, ʿibāda (33:35, 3:17, 66:5), giving it a real differentia: standing obedient devotedness, not bare obedience or worship.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 33:31 (Allah and His Messenger) and 4:34 (marital frame, no human object) are internal boundaries reconciled to this cluster: neither introduces a purely human object, so both remain God-ward obedient devotedness.

reconciliation.rationale: Internally the verse gives qānitāt no human object; human-directed obedience in the very same verse is carried by a different root (أَطَعْنَكُمْ, ط و ع). The narrowest Quran-internal reading is God-ward obedient devotedness, so 4:34 reinforces the qnt/ṭwʿ boundary rather than establishing a human-directed sense; it is an adversarial boundary, not a resistant seam.

The widening is only to God's Messenger as bearer of divine authority, never to an ordinary human; directional subordination to the Sovereign is preserved. It bounds, but does not falsify, the God-locked directionality.

adversarial_verification.notes: The thin nucleus 'obedient subordination to the Sovereign' survives all 13, but the fuller distinctive characterization (durative devotional standing-obedience) is refuted for the cosmic sub-class (2:116, 30:26), where the reading that fits everything loses distinctiveness from generic ṭāʿa. Because the core holds while a coherent sub-class resists the distinctive claim, a clean SUPPORTED/distinctiveness_ok/no-failing-occurrences pass is not achievable; the resistant occurrences are recorded rather than a PASSED grade asserted.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A occurrence/directionality, B nucleus/derivation-family, C adversarial) converged on the same nucleus, the same resistant cosmic seam, and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE cap.
candidate_root_contribution: qnt = a durative, settled posture of obedient subordination / sustained availability directed to a sovereign authority — invariantly Allah in every explicit case (once jointly to Allah and His Messenger, 33:31). In rational agents this is realized as willed, humble, standing devotional obedience before God (prototypically prolonged standing/night-vigil prayer); in the totality of creation it is involuntary ontological subjection. The single core that survives all 13 is directional 'standing-under / at the disposal of the Sovereign', not any specific act.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13/13 read: 11 active participles (qānit/qānitūn/qānitīn/qānitāt across gender-number) plus verb yaqnut (33:31) and imperative uqnutī (3:43); every explicit object is li-llāh/lahū/li-rabbi, extended once to li-llāh wa-rasūlihī (33:31); durativity marked in 39:9 (آنَاءَ ٱللَّيْلِ) and كان/كانت framings (16:120, 66:12).
layer_attribution.derivation: A single tight Form-I family with no augmented (II–X) stems; the active-participle dominance (11/13) signals a settled quality/standing-orientation rather than a punctual act. The N vs ADJ tag on identical قَٰنِتَٰت (66:5 vs 33:35/4:34) is a POS-position artifact, not a semantic class.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One derivational family, not multiple unbridged senses; the cosmic-vs-human split is a bridged contextual spectrum (ontological vs volitional realizations of the same subordination), so claim_scope_kind = DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, not LEXICALIZED_CLASS.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Collocations (standing/qiyām, sujūd, rukūʿ, night-vigil, dawn istighfār) and the marital frame of 4:34 supply the devotional/obedience-to-husband coloring; these are contextual and must NOT be promoted into the root claim — qnt frames but is not identical to those acts, and gives 4:34 no human object.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 4:34 (preliminary RESISTANT, 'obedient wife') and 33:31 (preliminary STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY, compound object) were reconciled to CONSISTENT: neither introduces a purely human object; human-directed obedience uses ط و ع (أَطَعْنَكُمْ) in the same 4:34, and 33:31 widens only to the Messenger as bearer of divine authority.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The cosmic sub-class 2:116/30:26 (كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ) persists as a coherent resistant seam: it realizes only the thin subordination core, loses distinctiveness from generic ṭāʿa, and is the reason the account is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL.

hard_cases.reason: Creation-wide predication forces the nucleus down to involuntary subjection, stripping the devotional richness of the human cases and preventing a STRONG grade.

evidence_basis.statement: كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ predicates qnt of the totality of creation in the heavens and earth, including the deniers being rebutted, so qnt here is involuntary universal subjection and cannot mean chosen devout worship.

hard_cases.reason: Verbatim parallel confirming the resistant cosmic sub-class is recurring and formulaic, not incidental.

evidence_basis.statement: The verbatim parallel كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ applied to all in the heavens and earth confirms an ontological, non-volitional subjection sense, resisting the distinctive devotional reading.

hard_cases.reason: Maximal interpretive pressure toward a human-directed 'obedient wife' lexicalization; used to test whether qnt ever takes a human object.

evidence_basis.statement: فَٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ قَٰنِتَٰتٌ occurs in a marital frame yet supplies no human object; the same verse reserves human-directed obedience for أَطَعْنَكُمْ (root ط و ع), so the internal reading is God-ward devotion, not obedience to a husband.

hard_cases.reason: Only occurrence widening the target beyond God alone; tests the God-locked directionality invariant.

evidence_basis.statement: يَقْنُتْ ... لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ is the only widening of the target beyond God alone, and it extends only to God and His Messenger as bearer of His authority, never to a purely human authority.

hard_case_representation.rationale: Each hard case is grounded in a specific Quran-internal observation from the packet (subject scope, object structure, or in-verse root contrast). The two RESISTANT_SEAM cases (2:116, 30:26) are the coherent resistant cosmic sub-class that caps the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE; the two ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY cases (4:34, 33:31) were tested and reconciled to the nucleus without introducing a human-directed sense.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A qnt occurrence whose stated object is an ordinary human authority (not Allah, and not the Messenger as bearer of divine authority), OR a demonstration that the cosmic كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ cases carry volitional devotional content — either would break the 'obedient subordination directed to the Sovereign (God)' nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 13 packet occurrences, especially the object slot after qnt (li- phrases in 16:120, 2:238, 3:43, 33:31, 2:116, 30:26) and the subject scope of 2:116/30:26; and the marital token 4:34:16:1.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Read each verse_text; confirm the governed party of the lām / the referent of the predication from Quran-internal context only; check whether human-directed obedience in the same verse uses a different root (e.g. ط و ع in 4:34).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not import classical 'obedient wife' or 'ritual qunut' lexicalizations; distinguish contextual collocation (qiyām, night-vigil) from the root's own contribution; treat the N/ADJ tag split on identical قَٰنِتَٰت as a POS artifact, not a semantic class.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a genuine human-object qnt is found, the God-locked directionality invariant collapses and the account degrades toward generic ṭāʿa (WEAK/UNRESOLVED); if the cosmic cases prove devotional, the two-class seam dissolves and a stronger unified devotional claim would be reconsidered.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal reading establishes that the cosmic كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ (2:116, 30:26) does carry volitional devotional content, the two-class seam dissolves and a unified STRONG devotional claim should be re-examined.
If 4:34:16:1 (قَٰنِتَٰتٌ) is shown on Quran-internal grounds to take a human (spousal) object, the God-locked directionality invariant fails and the root must be re-graded toward generic obedience.
If a bridge is found that carries the full standing-devotional content of 39:9/2:238/3:43 into the cosmic cases without abstraction loss, the REPRESENTATIVE scope could be widened toward UNIVERSAL.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The thin nucleus 'obedient subordination to the Sovereign' survives all 13, but the fuller distinctive characterization (durative devotional standing-obedience) is refuted for the cosmic sub-class (2:116, 30:26), where the reading that fits everything loses distinctiveness from generic ṭāʿa. Because the core holds while a coherent sub-class resists the distinctive claim, a clean SUPPORTED/distinctiveness_ok/no-failing-occurrences pass is not achievable; the resistant occurrences are recorded rather than a PASSED grade asserted.
